passage:
A restaurant used AI translation for its menu. Most translations were helpful, but one dish name became very strange in English.
Tourists laughed and posted photos online. The owner felt embarrassed.
A local student offered to help review the menu. She explained that food names often need cultural understanding, not just direct translation.
The corrected menu still kept some original names, with short explanations.
The restaurant learned that translation is not only changing words. It is helping people understand without losing meaning.
AI made the first draft quickly. Human knowledge made it welcoming.
